title: Crispy Ukrainian Pilaf Bites
description: A crunchy twist on traditional pilaf, perfect as a snack or appetizer.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, combine the pilaf, nutty, and turmeric.
3. Mix in the crispy until well combined.
4. Using a small cookie scoop, form the mixture into balls.
5. Place the balls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
6. Bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
7. Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes.
